name: config-value-icons
goal: Config collections use distinct object and array icon controls with accurate counts and expandable read-only contents.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Replace config source snippets and View value text with distinct object and array icon controls. Show static attribute/item counts, expandable nested contents, and exact source without executing config code.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: Existing category-folder browser matrix only asserts compact row height and source modal text; fixtures lack arrays and nested objects. Extend that matrix plus the existing committed-config parser cases to cover structural counts, nested expansion, empty/spread values, source retention, and focus at all viewports.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: At test commit 279cde09b, retained red f3478ac8 records the actual visible View value assertion failure at desktop/tablet/mobile plus five missing structural metadata cases. Same test corpus and command frozen; original screenshots retained in Git evidence.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
